instruction.text: Count in powers of 10 to solve the problem.

atoms.a: A bamboo tree is <mat>263`cm`</mat> tall in January. It grows <mat>10`cm`</mat> taller in February, and another <mat>10`cm`</mat> taller in March. How tall is the bamboo tree in February and March?
atoms.sound: A bamboo tree is 263 centimetres tall in January. It grows 10 centimetres taller in February, and another 10 centimetres taller in March. How tall is the tree in February and March?

atoms.a: The local bakery made £38,000 this month. Last month, they made £1,000 less. How much money did the local bakery make last month?

The population of the United Kingdom is currently 67,000,000. It is expected to grow by another 1,000,000 in the next 5 years, and then by another million in the next 10 years. What will the population be in 5 and 10 years?

A rugby stadium has a capacity of 65,000 people. A cricket stadium nearby can hold 10,000 less people, and a football stadium in the same area holds 10,000 more than the rugby stadium. How many people can the stadiums hold?

The local election in Leeds this year included 64,340 participants. Manchester only had 100 more, Liverpool had 100 more than Manchester, and York had 100 fewer than Leeds. How many participants did each city have

The biggest house on St. James’ street in Winchester costs £1,980,000. The second biggest house on the street costs £100,000 less, and the smallest house is £1,000,000 less. How much do both houses cost?
atoms.sound: The biggest house on St. Jameses street in Winchester costs £1,980,000. The second biggest house on the street costs £100,000 less, and the smallest house is £1,000,000 less. How much do both houses cost?
